title: Make Intent location, source and candidate test setup map directly to the domain

intentCoverage.report:
# Dough Intent Coverage: Caught

**Story:** SEED-261#map-intent-and-ci-proof-test-data, "Make Intent location, source and candidate test setup map directly to the domain" (key example 1), read from `.planning/seeds/SEED-261-share-domain-test-data.md` at revision `5c3a78b58e65666fa1dcdf90b0b5bdf91e14fdc9`; plan `.planning/slice-plans/548-map-intent-and-ci-proof-test-data/PLAN.md` at the same revision.

**Promise.** An Open Dough-shaped project declares `dashboard/tests` TypeScript specs and `tests` shell checks, and Intent lists each location with the published files it selects. The test states the locations through MakeMe, and its expected tree is written independently. The converted case must still catch the same failure: the include pattern stated through `makeMe.anIntentLocation...ofKind("typescript", ["**/*.spec.ts"])` has to reach the product, and the independent expectation has to fail when the product selects the wrong files.

**Fault.** In `dashboard/src/intentLocationSelection.ts`, `sourceEntriesOf` (line 97) stopped applying a kind declaration's include patterns. The change was `...(location.include === undefined ? {} : { patterns: location.include }),` to `...({}),`. The declaration and its displayed patterns were unchanged. Only selection fell back to the kind's extensions, so any `.ts`/`.tsx` file (or `.sh`/`.bash` file) under the location was listed. The server listing, `file-at` admission and the browser share this selection rule. The fixture and the assertion were not edited.

**Fixture.** `dashboard/tests/intent/intent-code-browse.spec.ts:27`, "Intent lists matched code test files under include patterns, omits helpers and product files, and reads exact text with the observed revision". It builds settings with `makeMe.intentSettings.withLocations(...)`: `dashboard/tests`, `dashboard/frontend-tests` and `dashboard/backend-tests` as `typescript` with `**/*.spec.ts`, and `tests` as `shell` with `*.sh`. It publishes them through `publishIntentProject` (settings encoded by `intentSettingsText`) with spec files and helper files, including `dashboard/tests/intentPerspectivePage.ts`.

**Maintained assertion.** Step "Ex 1", lines 125-130: the `dashboard/tests/intentPerspectivePage.ts` button in the Intent main region `toHaveCount(0)`.

**Run observations.** All runs used a scratch `git worktree add --detach` checkout at `5c3a78b58`. Before the runs it was clean (`git status --porcelain` empty) and had been through `node scripts/setup-native.mjs npm`, `browser` and `check` (all exit 0). The command each time was `env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" npm run test:dashboard -- tests/intent/intent-code-browse.spec.ts -g "Intent lists matched code test files" --workers=1 --reporter=list`, with `--retries=0` added on the fault run. Load averages were about 13.7 to 21 from other worktrees.
- Baseline: 1 passed. The selected test ran (11.4 s; 16.3 s whole run).
- Fault: 1 failed in step "Ex 1" at `intent-code-browse.spec.ts:130`, `expect(locator).toHaveCount(expected) failed ... Expected: 0, Received: 1` for the `dashboard/tests/intentPerspectivePage.ts` button.
  - **Reach:** the failure is at the intended assertion. The earlier assertions in that step passed under the fault: the `dashboard/tests` heading contains `typescript` and `**/*.spec.ts`, and every grouped spec button is visible after the folders expand. So the MakeMe-stated include pattern was published and read.
  - **Independent behavior evidence:** the Playwright error-context page snapshot shows the heading list `"typescript, **/*.spec.ts files under dashboard/tests"` with the button `"dashboard/tests/intentPerspectivePage.ts"` listed under it. The location still names its pattern but selects a helper that the pattern excludes, which is the intended wrong behavior on the listing path.
- Restoration: an `EXIT/INT/TERM` trap ran `git checkout -- dashboard/src/intentLocationSelection.ts` and printed `restored`. Afterwards `git diff --quiet` held and `git status --porcelain` was empty, the same as before the probe. The only other entries were the ignored run outputs `dashboard/test-results/` and `node_modules`. HEAD was still `5c3a78b58`. Rerunning the same command: 1 passed (7.4 s; 8.8 s whole run). The scratch worktree was then removed with `git worktree remove --force`. The project checkout was not edited.

**Outcome: Caught.** The converted MakeMe setup carries the include-pattern fact to the product. Its independent expectation that `dashboard/tests/intentPerspectivePage.ts` is not listed fails when kind locations stop applying their include patterns.

## Cost

- **Test runtime.** Measured by the Playwright list reporter (per-test duration and whole-run total, wall seconds). Baseline 11.4 s test, 16.3 s run. Fault 16.3 s test, failing including its 5 s assertion timeout. Restored 7.4 s test, 8.8 s run. Total about 35 s of test duration. The machine was loaded (load average 13.7 to 21).
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No human took part in this delegated run, and no separate measure of human time is recorded.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. The host exposes no separately supported measure of agent tokens or active agent time for this run.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 161116 ms (measured), from 1794208884132 to 1794209045248 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
